family: The single total uniform norm-one finite-field predicate in proof.md: f_n=0 for n<64; otherwise use its deterministic quadratic-tower binary basis of dimension m=n-o(n), ignore the remaining tail and accept iff z^((2^m-1)/(2^k-1))=1, with the exact all-length choices of m,d,k in Section 1.
theorem: For this fixed polynomial-time computable family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, liminf over all integer input lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 62405759/12405759 in the full Li-Yang binary Boolean circuit model.
